rationale: newjordan's promoted harness (PR #233, main's submission/ at d0929e6) is this package's controller for the fresh embark (OP1) and the four lab tasks, unchanged: plain/, overseer/ and tests/ are byte-identical to main's, with the shared dfbench_client/. Everything it does in those games is its own work and that of the sources its declaration lists (our PR #124's tree and its lineage among them). This package adds only dispatch/ (which controller plays the task) and ours/ (the controller for the handed-over fort, declared in the next entry).
evidence: Source: submission/plain/ and submission/overseer/ at the published commit d0929e6a0ff8eb7144206ceed2c6588038c84a3f. Target: the same paths in this package, byte-identical (the cited functions are two examples: Overseer.progression_push, the wood-tool wealth push, and OpenPlayRules.thaw_window).

rationale: Our own PR #229 (arm d81) is this package's controller for the handed-over fort (MY1), unchanged: its plain/ and overseer/ are at ours/plain and ours/overseer, byte-identical, and its tests at ours/tests. dispatch/ runs it for an open task shorter than a year. Its own declaration lists what it is built on; the entries below declare directly the sources of that tree that main's declaration does not list. Declared although RULES section 8 makes one's own earlier submissions optional.
evidence: Source: submission/plain/ and submission/overseer/ at the published commit 602b986f561b4ff6672d769d3038b6fba4d908f4. rationale: 0xmoei's published harness moves a manager's office that can't take a chair: a new office zone where a chair fits, the chair placed there and the zone given to the manager, because DF validates no manager order from about 20 citizens without an office chair. This candidate's office step on its open tasks rests on that idea; its own parts are reading every office the manager owns, keeping offices off farm levels, retiring a site where the game refuses the chair, rooms before day 10 and the chair ordered for the office first. In this package that code is in ours/, the controller for the handed-over fort (MY1), unchanged from our e884d63b.

Target: Overseer.office_open(), Overseer.office_chair(), Overseer.office_fits() and Overseer.office_site() in overseer/harness.py. Target paths are under ours/ in this package (submission/ours/...).

rationale: yukonautominer's published harness (PR #161) offers a W site to no other workshop type once a workshop was placed on it in the same pass: the observation stays as it was through a pass, so the site still looks free. This package does the same on its open tasks (MY1, OP1), where the Still and Kitchen used to be sent to the Carpenters' site in the same pass, refused (site_used) and held back by the action backoff until day 4 to 8. A refused build reserves nothing in either; the lab tasks keep the earlier per-type check. In this package that code is in ours/, the controller for the handed-over fort (MY1), unchanged from our e884d63b.
evidence: Source: Overseer.build() in overseer/harness.py at the published commit dc81809cb9f52c952dd4e27be58672575df9af2a (the site check over every type in full_sites). Target: SITE_ANY_TYPE and Overseer.build() in overseer/harness.py. Target paths are under ours/ in this package (submission/ours/...).

rationale: yukonautominer's published harness (PR #168) starts the hunger cull's cooldown only when the pass marked an animal: a check that found nothing it may slaughter (every animal left kept for the feast) used to start it too, so a food-zero emergency days later waited out the 5 or 8 days. This package makes the same one-line change in its own cull() on the open tasks (the lab tasks never reach it); the comment there credits them. In 366 of our local games the old rule held back such a cull in 18, inside the scored last 28 days in 7. In this package that code is in ours/, the controller for the handed-over fort (MY1), unchanged from our e884d63b.
evidence: Source: OpenPlayRules.cull() in overseer/openplay.py at the published commit 160b0abb552b93be81fc544eda04c07f98f8d3e2 ('if marked:' before the cooldown is set). Target: OpenPlayRules.cull() in overseer/openplay.py, where 'if marked or not pick:' became 'if marked:'. Target paths are under ours/ in this package (submission/ours/...).

rationale: yukonautominer's published harness (PR #178) builds a strange mood's workshop again when the listed one has stood with its construction suspended: its mood() reads the controller's own shops(), which leaves such a workshop out, where the leader's code read the raw workshop list and waited on it for good. The same harness cancels the controller's own standing wood-crafts order once created wealth reaches the target (first in their PR #165, 11ff6d2a, declared in its own entry): the leader's code only stopped adding the order, so three crafts a day were made to the end of the game. This package makes both changes in its own mood() and progression_push(); the comments there credit them. The cancel here is final once the game accepts it. In this package that code is in ours/, the controller for the handed-over fort (MY1), unchanged from our e884d63b.
evidence: Source: Overseer.mood() and Overseer.progression_push() in overseer/harness.py at the published commit 9c10c029024697809331f10ba74899d44b65246d ('have = self.shops()'; the cancel_order loop over craft_ids at the wealth target). Target: the same two functions in overseer/harness.py. Target paths are under ours/ in this package (submission/ours/...).

rationale: newjordan's published harness (PR #192) places beds on a migrant task up to the number the controller makes, max(citizens + 12, 50), where the leader's code made that many and placed citizens + 2 (first in their PR #186, a6dcf695, declared in its own entry). This package does the same in the lab branch of furnish(); the comment there credits them. Their endgame_supply() also adds a brew order from the start of the end-of-game slaughter (o_brew_f_end, first in their PR #190, 4a672cff, declared in its own entry). This package's feast() brews the plants its endgame order holds back once the slaughtered meat is in stock, while drink is under 20 a citizen, as one-shot orders: written from our own local games before we read theirs, but the same idea, published earlier. In this package that code is in ours/, the controller for the handed-over fort (MY1), unchanged from our e884d63b.

Target: Overseer.furnish() in overseer/harness.py and OpenPlayRules.feast() in overseer/openplay.py (the o_brew_feast order). Target paths are under ours/ in this package (submission/ours/...).
